rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
There are four steps to building a family budget. 💰You have already covered:
1️⃣ Step 1: identifying needs and wants.

2️⃣ Today, you will learn about Step 2: talking about monthly expenses.
rows.text_2::eng:
🔑 Knowing what your family’s monthly expenses are can be helpful for everyone in your family. 

💡 It can help them understand why money is being spent on some things and not on others.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: Let's get started with an activity!
rows.text_2::eng: 📝 Get a piece of paper (or old newspaper or a cardboard box) and a pen.

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng: 🎨 Draw pictures of all the things that you and your family spend money on each month.
📝 Write next to each picture how much each thing costs.
💰 Add up how much money you have to spend each month.
Take a picture of the paper or save it for Step 3! ⭐

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: Are you ready for today’s home activity? ⭐ It’s time to add up your monthly expenses.
